name: Surface Painting Mode with Normal Map Guidance
definition: A mode allowing painting on volumetric surfaces by generating an isosurface via MIDA ray casting, storing ray position and object normal in 2D buffers, and using mouse cursor position to override brush depth and orientation.
summary: Surface Painting Mode automatically aligns brush depth and orientation to an isosurface using a normal map, decoupling the brush from the geometry to paint volumetric envelopes.
